visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish whether the withdrawal succeeded, whether fees or additional requirements applied, or what the status messages specifically said.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin participation by presenting recurring paid benefits as withdrawable earnings while instructing viewers to buy coins and move funds between accounts to obtain a withdrawal. It gives a specific 790-euro withdrawal workflow with fees and a stated 10-week payout expectation, then directs sponsored or team members to seek guidance, encouraging participation rather than warning or investigating.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video links purchasing OneCoin tokens to claimed earnings and the ability to withdraw those earnings. The demonstrated purchase of 40 coins is presented as part of the process for realizing the promised account benefits, rather than as neutral market commentary.
